Frequently asked questions

How do I access Make Space?

As soon as your payment is confirmed, you will receive an email with an access link and open the web app on your mobile phone, tablet, or computer.

Is this a video course?

No. It is an interactive app with questions, decision paths, progress tracking and saved items.

Do I need organizing experience?

No. You start by choosing one item and answering simple questions.

Does it work for any type of object?

Yes. The method is designed to handle any item that carries emotion, from clothing to family keepsakes.

What if I cannot let something go?

Choose Not Sure and save it for later. The app gives the decision more time instead of forcing a discard.

What if I have a lot of accumulated clutter?

Perfect. The greater the mess, the greater the sense of relief. The method breaks things down into small steps that add up.

Is this a minimalist program?

No. You can keep books, clothes, decorations and meaningful belongings. The goal is a home that supports your current life.

Is Make Space therapy for hoarding?

No. It is a self-guided organization and reflection tool for everyday clutter and difficult decisions.
